{{Quote|A starship captain was assaulted upon leaving the cantina. The strange part is that he wasn't robbed. They attacked him and then left without taking anything. This is obviously not just a mugging. Look into it. You'll find the starship captain, Osto Grissom, near the cantina.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Alana Walden|Walden]]|<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB" />}}
'''Osto Grissom''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|So they attacked me just because I transport electronics?? What did I tell you? Those Meatlumps are crazy.|Osto Grissom|<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Grissom was spending the night at the [[Tyrena cantina]] in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. When he left the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], he was attacked by [[Meatlumps]]. The technology-hating Meatlumps had picked him, because he transported electronics into and out of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. Grissom however didn't know why they had attacked him and offered them some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], which they ignored. The starship captain was lucky, as a large group of people left the cantina at this moment and scared the Meatlumps off.<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB" />

Grissom reported the incident to the [[Corellian Security Force]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Alana Walden|Walden]] tasked an independent agent with the investigations of the Meatlump attack. After questioning Grissom about the incident, the agent sought out camps of the Meatlumps outside of the city that led the agent to the [[Meatlump Cave]]. There the agent found the Meatlump lieutenant [[Ubbal Fenn]] who revealed the reason for the attack on Grissom. Grissom couldn't believe it when the agent told him about his findings.<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Osto Grissom was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Osto Grissom was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref> He could be found outside of the Tyrena cantina on Corellia. He was part of the quest "[[:w:c:swg:CorSec Case Files: Assault and Battery|CorSec Case Files: Assault and Battery]]," which was a part of the [[:w:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy quest]], the longest quest line of the game.<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB" />
